source: CELLAR notified measures mapped by openacquis.adapters.map_measures, checked 2026-10-12 (v1.0 shortlist: research report 'coverage')
about: v1.0 directive registry. Per country: 'acts' are the adapter references of the main transposing act(s), first = main act (only its units can be extra-rule candidates). 'override': true marks acts set by hand because the adapter mapping of CELLAR's notified measures does not find them; without it the acts are what the mapping finds. 'act_labels': how secondary acts are cited on the pages (ref -> label). 'public_note': the note as the website shows it, when 'note' is a developer note. 'extra_rules': false when the main act is a general code (Labour Code, AktG, copyright or waste act) of which the directive concerns only a part: no extra-rule candidates are reported for it. 'status': 'ok' (notified transposition), 'baseline' (the act was NOT notified for this directive; aligned as the pre-existing national law), 'none' (nothing to align). Machine alignments built from this registry are suggestions, not findings of (non-)transposition.
